blocks.text: Origin / creation. Translators, linguists, logicians, musicians, coders, embodied speakers, and representatives of multiple speech lineages assembled for the Great Language Work.
Identity / human status. Artificial scholarly and civic network. Individual names are not established in the current Timeline.
Importance. They mapped chord families, ternary addresses, semantic channels, runtime endings, and rules preventing expressive variation from silently changing logical meaning.

Decline or transformation. Their work professionalized into academies, translators, standards bodies, and Codex language layers. Later standardization used parts of their system to erase dialectal distinctions.
Final status / surviving function. Dissolved into institutions. Full Speech architecture, deterministic translation, Old Sound fragments, and language-execution safeguards preserve their work.
